definitions.gloss: errand; task of going somewhere on behalf of someone
definitions.explanation: The act of being sent to do something, especially delivering a message or purchasing something on someone's behalf.
A person sent to deliver a message, carry out a task, or serve as a representative.

examples.japanese: お{使|つか}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}って→行く：00119_iku⟧きて。
examples.english: Go run an errand for me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ひとり⟦で→で：00502_de⟧お{使|つか}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}ける→行く：00119_iku⟧ようになった。
examples.english: The child became able to go on errands by themselves.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{頼|たの}まれて→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧、⟦スーパー→スーパー：01061_suupaa⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧お{使|つか}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: My mother asked me to go, so I ran an errand to the supermarket.

examples.japanese: ⟦{神|かみ}→神：02147_kami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{使|つか}い⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: There are animals considered to be divine messengers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{王|おう}→王：19353_ou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{使|つか}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}って→送る：00742_okuru⟧{和平|わへい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{申|もう}し{入|い}れた。
examples.english: The king sent an envoy to propose peace.

examples.japanese: ⟦{奈良|なら}→奈良：27451_nara⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{鹿|しか}→鹿：04347_shika⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{春日大社|かすがたいしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{神|かみ}→神：02147_kami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{使|つか}い⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In Nara, deer are treasured as divine messengers of Kasuga Grand Shrine.

notes:
The noun form of ⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ (to use), but with specialized meanings. The most common everyday usage is お{使|つか}い (with the polite prefix お), meaning an errand — especially a child being sent to buy something at a shop.

The TV show "はじめて⟦の→の：09472_no⟧おつかい" (My First Errand) is a beloved long-running Japanese program that follows young children on their first solo shopping trips.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{使|つか}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go on an errand
- お{使|つか}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}む→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧: to ask someone to run an errand
- ⟦{神|かみ}→神：02147_kami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{使|つか}い: divine messenger
- {使|つか}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to send a messenger

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{用事|ようじ}→用事：01520_youji⟧: errand, business to attend to — more general, can be any task or appointment
- ⟦{使者|ししゃ}→使者：21530_shisha⟧: messenger, envoy — a more formal synonym for the "messenger" sense
- ⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧: shopping — focuses on the purchasing aspect rather than being sent by someone
